title: Adaptive Layer-Wise Transformations for Post-Training Quantization of Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2511.17809v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models require significant computational resources for deployment, making quantization essential for practical applications. However, the main obstacle to effective quantization lies in systematic outliers in activations and weights, which cause substantial LLM performance degradation, especially at low-bit settings. While existing transformation-based methods like affine and rotation transformations successfully mitigate outliers, they apply the homogeneous transformation setting, i.e., using the same transformation types across all layers, ignoring the heterogeneous distribution characteristics within LLMs. In this paper, we propose an adaptive transformation selection framework that systematically determines optimal transformations on a per-layer basis. To this end, we first formulate transformation selection as a differentiable optimization problem to achieve the accurate transformation type for each layer. However

translated_title: 大语言模型训练后量化的自适应逐层变换方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型的部署需要大量计算资源，因此量化对于实际应用至关重要。然而，实现有效量化的主要障碍在于激活值和权重中的系统性离群值，它们会导致大语言模型性能显著下降，尤其是在低比特设置下。虽然现有的基于变换的方法（如仿射变换和旋转变换）能够成功缓解离群值问题，但它们采用同质的变换设置，即在所有层中使用相同的变换类型，忽略了大语言模型内部异质的分布特性。在本文中，我们提出了一种自适应变换选择框架，能够系统地逐层确定最优变换。为此，我们首先将变换选择形式化为一个可微优化问题，以便为每一层准确地选择变换类型。然而……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种自适应逐层变换选择框架，将变换选择形式化为可微优化问题，从而为大语言模型训练后量化中的每一层自动选择最优变换类型，以有效缓解激活值和权重中的系统性离群值问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an adaptive transformation selection framework that formulates transformation selection as a differentiable optimization problem, enabling per-layer optimal transformation selection to mitigate systematic outliers in post-training quantization of large language models.
